description: One-call due diligence on any ERC-20 on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon: 0-100 safety score and grade, owner powers found in the bytecode (mint, pause, blacklist, fees, trading switch), proxy and ownership status, Sourcify source verification, deployer, and the deepest Uniswap v3 pool with USD price and pool depth. Use before buying, listing or integrating a token. Replaces about 6 separate calls.
name: token_due_diligence_report
title: Token Due-Diligence Report
